playerActions.text: I ask Aldric what he knows of Queen Underbough — whether the Queen is in residence in the town that bears her name, and what manner of ruler she is.

I thank Aldric, leave the boardwalk and climb the rise to the manor house at the top of the town. At its iron gate I announce myself to the guard as Corin Vale, caravan guard, and request an audience with Queen Underbough herself. I wait to be received.
I step back from the gate into the rain and watch the woman on the palisade walk, trying to make out who she is before I decide where to go next.
I find a dockhand hauling rope near the watch-shed and ask him plainly who the tall woman on the palisade walk is — the one the archers bow to.
I nod at what he tells me and ask him where this woman keeps her household — the manor, or somewhere else in the town.
I thank him with a copper, then look up at the palisade walk again to see whether she is still watching me.
I keep my distance and ask the nearest sentry, quietly, whether the captain on the gatehouse step is kin to Jareth the dockhand, and what his name is.
I watch the lord read his letter and ask the sentry beside me, under my breath, whether that is the River Baron himself or some other Mordrath.

gmAnswers.prose: "No queen sits here, sellsword, nor has one ever drawn breath in the Reach. This mud-heap belongs to the River Baron, and if it's the Underbough blood you mean, you speak of Wilhelmina, the baron's sister…"
"There is no queen behind this wall. Mistress Wilhelmina takes no uninvited vagrants from the mud…"
…the cloaked figure pacing the walkway… The archers along the parapet do not merely let her pass; they snap rigid…
